notes.zh: 新增应用内下载更新、进度、取消及SHA256校验；运行中卸载先询问退出；覆盖安装保留原配置及快捷方式选择。报告改为Markdown（.md），原生预览支持标题、列表、表格和代码，兼容旧TXT。
notes.en: Adds in-app update downloads, progress, cancellation and SHA256 verification; uninstall asks before exiting a running app, and updates preserve settings and shortcut choices. Reports use Markdown (.md) with native formatted previews and legacy TXT compatibility.

notes.zh: 报告改为Markdown（.md），完整显示标题、加粗、嵌套列表、链接、表格和代码块，兼容旧TXT；新增复制原文及打开报告。含应用内更新、安装失败恢复与中英双语帮助菜单。
notes.en: Reports now use Markdown (.md) with formatted headings, bold, nested lists, links, tables and code blocks, plus legacy TXT compatibility and copy/open actions. Includes in-app updates, rollback and a bilingual Help menu.

notes.zh: 报告改为Markdown（.md），完整显示标题、加粗、嵌套列表、链接、表格和代码块，兼容旧TXT；新增复制原文及打开报告。含应用内更新、安装失败恢复与中英双语帮助菜单。
notes.en: Reports now use Markdown (.md) with formatted headings, bold, nested lists, links, tables and code blocks, plus legacy TXT compatibility and copy/open actions. Includes in-app updates, rollback and a bilingual Help menu.
